title: Saudi Arabian Noodle Dish
description: A hearty and flavorful noodle dish inspired by the cuisine of Saudi Arabia. This recipe is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.

ingredients.name: Arabian
ingredients.notes: Use as spice blend or mix with a little oil as marinade

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the noodle according to the package instructions until al dente.
Drain the noodle and set it aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of Arabian spice blend or oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped nuts and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly toasted.
Add the cooked noodle to the skillet and stir to combine with the nuts and spice blend.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
